result.summary: Found 1 issue: a broken image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section that affects visual quality and user experience.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a gray placeholder with a broken image icon instead of the actual food image, making it impossible to see what the restaurant offers.
issues.suggestion: Replace the broken image placeholder with the actual restaurant food image or a proper default image to maintain visual consistency and provide users with visual information about the restaurant.
